Ke(kai)yadeva
son of Śārṅgadeva an. grandson of Padmanābha; of Bhāradvāja gotra.
--Nāmaratnākara. med. lex. Bikaner 4089-92. also ref. in the beg. of Pathyāpathyavibodhaka.
--Nighaṇṭu or Keyadevanighaṇṭu. See Pathyāpathyavibodhaka, below.
--Pathyāpathyavibodha(ka). dictionary of materia medica an. hygiene. BORI. [Page043-a. D. XVI. i. 126.

. Weber 1748.
--Prayogasāra. med. See J. of Assam Res. Soc.
